params.prompt: A hairline line drawing in one single red ink on pure white paper, in the manner of an architect's first site sketch made before anything is built: one confident continuous pen weight throughout, open linework, no shading, no hatching, no grey tones, no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos. Beneath the lines, one flat pale wash of warm sand colour laid loosely under the path and the building only, like a single marker stroke that does not stay inside the lines; nothing else is coloured. A few short dimension ticks along one edge of the path and one small registration cross in a corner, as on a plan. Generous white space. Portrait format. Redraw the attached photograph as this kind of line drawing, keeping its exact composition, horizon line, camera height and the positions of the path, the cyclist, the building, the grasses and the survey stakes, so that the drawing would register over the photograph. Subject: a shallow rocky creek winding from the lower right foreground into the middle distance, a woman in a light jumper sitting on a boulder at the lower left with her back to the viewer looking across the water, tall grasses and reeds on both banks, a stand of cottonwood trees rising on the left, a long low data center with a row of rooftop dry-cooling units sitting beyond the scrub in the middle distance, a walker on a path to the right, and dry rounded hills behind; the sky left as empty paper.
